---
title: "Predicción de demanda eléctrica en Victoria (Australia)"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(TTR)
library(fpp3)

vic <- vic_elec %>%

  as_tibble() %>%

  mutate(Date = as_date(Time)) %>%

  group_by(Date) %>%

  summarise(Demand = sum(Demand))
```

```{r}
vic_ts <- ts(
  vic$Demand,
  frequency = 7
)

autoplot(vic_ts) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Demanda (MW)"
  )
```

```{r}
decomp_stl <- stl(vic_ts, s.window = "periodic")

autoplot(decomp_stl) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
